description: Code review follow-up fixes: Remove non-null assertions on user!, address no-op middleware, consolidate localStorage key duplication into shared storage module, document unreachable OpenAI code path, add onboarding state persistence across refreshes.
steps: Replace user! non-null assertions with proper null checks in match detail, dashboard, and pod detail pages.
Add a comment to middleware.ts explaining it is a placeholder for future Supabase session checks (or remove).

Create src/lib/data/storage.ts that owns all localStorage keys and exposes typed accessors for conversations, members, and messages. Update realtime.ts, pod-actions.ts, and event-actions.ts to use shared accessor.
Add comment to src/lib/ai/index.ts explaining the OpenAI path requires an API route and the template fallback is intentionally always used in the current architecture.
Add persistence to onboarding so refreshing mid-flow does not lose progress - save each step's data to localStorage and restore on page load.
acceptance_criteria: No user! non-null assertions remain in page components
Middleware has a clear comment about its purpose or is removed
A single storage.ts module owns all localStorage keys for chat data
realtime.ts, pod-actions.ts, and event-actions.ts use shared storage accessors
AI module clearly documents why OpenAI path is unreachable from client
Onboarding state persists across page refreshes
findings: All 5 review issues addressed. Storage consolidation removed ~60 lines of duplicated code. The onboarding persistence saves both step number and form data as a single JSON object. No new test failures introduced. Build succeeds cleanly (21 routes). The middleware deprecation warning is a Next.js 16 thing - it recommends 'proxy' instead but middleware still works.
